iha: [(1)ima+ha] (bya) CL=8 Kaccaññaḥ. 234,254.moga,4.100.(2)idaṃ+ha. Nīti, sutta.463,503]In this ... In this Sāsanāto.
ihalokika: [Iha+loka+ika] (ti) CL=8 Ihaloke jātaṃ ihalokikaṃ. Dhāna,ṭī.85]  it is happened in present life, (effect) meet and experience in this life.
ihaṭṭhaka: [Ihaṭṭha(=iha+ṭhā+a)+ka] (ti) CL=8 it is lie in this sensual life, a person who is being in eleven levels of existence given to the pursuit of sensual pleasure; he. Ihaṭṭhakanijjhānika- see.
ihaṭṭhakanijjhānika: [Ihaṭṭhaka+nijjhānika] (ti) CL=8 There is no worldly Jhana in this sensual life, this human life and in deity life; he.
